title: Event context
detail: On 2 December 1997, the Government of Bangladesh and PCJSS signed the Chittagong Hill Tracts Peace Accord. The accord ended large-scale insurgency under the Shanti Bahini framework, introduced institutional commitments on autonomy and land issues, and began a long implementation process.

title: Why it mattered
detail: The accord remains crucial for understanding citizenship, indigeneity, land rights, and center-periphery state relations in Bangladesh.
